resources.string: FlowBubble reads the focused text field and any selected text so it can insert your dictation, replace a selection you asked to edit, and perform taps or scrolling you request by voice. It does not read passwords, send messages, or act without your explicit command.
Shows when the FlowBubble trigger is active and whether the microphone is recording.
Shows while FlowBubble can see the screen for on-device reading and actions.
On-device OCR only. Nothing is recorded or uploaded. Tap Stop to end screen access.
